indications: Uses For external treatment of abrasions and minor cuts.

label.Active ingredient: Active ingredient Gentian Violet 0.1% Purpose First Aid Antiseptic
label.Indications and usage: Uses For external treatment of abrasions and minor cuts.
label.Dosage and administration: Directions Clean the affected area and apply directly to the wound or use a cotton applicator once or twice daily. Do not bandage.
label.Warnings: Warnings For external treatment of abrasions and minor cuts Do not Do not apply to an ulcerative lesions as this may cause tattooing of the skin. Do not use in eyes Stop use and ask a doctor if redness, irritation, swelling, or pain persists or increases or if infection occurs. Keep out of reach of children. In case of ingestion, seek medical help or contact Poison Control Center immediately.
